params.name: warmpool_name
params.help: Name of a MANAGED or CUSTOM warm pool in the owning project. Runtime and shape are derived from the pool; explicit values must match. Deleting pools cannot be used. Snapshot restore, credential brokerage, and nested resource principals are not supported with named pools. An empty pool may cold-create using its same template, including when desired capacity is zero. Zero capacity stops idle prewarming; it does not prevent creation from an available applied template. When warmpoolName is omitted, a built-in runtime can automatically select an eligible named MANAGED pool in the same project matching its runtime and shape. Omitted runtime defaults to python-3.11 and omitted shape defaults to SMALL for automatic matching. A digest-pinned customer image can automatically select an eligible CUSTOM pool in the same project matching its canonical registry host, repository, digest and shape. Tag-based customer images are not automatically matched. Matching pools are considered in name order; the first with a valid applied template is selected without reading ready counts. Empty pools and zero desired or applied capacity still allow cold creation through the selected template. If no eligible pool is found or automatic lookup is unavailable, built-in runtimes use the existing managed runtime path, and customer images use the ordinary direct customer-image path with its existing validation. Automatic matching does not apply when source is supplied, including snapshot restore, or when credential brokerage or nested resource principals are used. Explicit names retain strict validation and do not fall back to automatic matching or another creation path. Retries preserve the original persisted pool binding or the original managed or direct customer-image route, even when matching pools change. Sandbox and SandboxSummary report an automatically selected pool in warmpoolName.
